questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

options.text: h s d z c h c s
h s d m z h c s
h s d m z h d s
h d s m z h c s

questions.solution:
Given: d _ m c _ z _ h _ c s _ d _ m _ _ z

1. h s d z c h c s → d **h** m c **s** z - **d** h **z** c s **c -** d **h** m **c** **s** z

2. h s d m z h c s → d h m c s z - d h **m** c s **z** - d h m c s z

3. h s d m z h d s → d h m c s z - d h **m** c s **z** - d h m **d** s z

4. h d s m z h c s → d h m c **d** z - **s** h **m** c s **z** - d h m c s z

questions.question: Seven friends K, L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting in a straight line all facing the same direction. N is sitting at one of the corners. O is fourth to the right of Q. Only three persons are sitting between M and L. Q is to the immediate left of P. O is second to the right of K. Only four persons are sitting between N and M. What is L’s position?

options.text: Third to the right of P
Second to the left of P

questions.solution:
**Seven friends: K, L, M, N, O, P and Q**

1) N is sitting at one of the corners.

2) Only four persons are sitting between N and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9cf26ae7542d80dde8402108f511bd0d668abf6e0445990188c130b54967ab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75394b7f6f4729a1d456ec2f72094390dc5adb972eee7a819e083cb0ff018ae3.png] 

5) Q is immediate left of P.

(It means case 2 is eliminated because there is no place left of P to sit immediate of Q in Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dccf8ab4f41ff0b9cb361d442a3d5a2f597a5a733000b8b2035da6890d162eca.png] 

6) Only one place are left and K is sit on that place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda5d6134b9fc1c663169e335e885c576a49d41b77e7fc0e5a97b6c28043e8b6.png] 

Clearly, we can see that L sit second to the left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Second to the left of P".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No restaurant is a shop.

All shops are schools.

All parks are shops.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some schools are parks.

II. Some parks are restaurants.

III. Some shops are parks.

options.text: Conclusions I, II and III follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c0f5008fc0fc9adb0af9a8c6ce660a136a34fc1acf387ca9dfaed2deea4aa8a.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. Some schools are parks → Follow → (As all shops are schools and all parks are shops so, some schools are parks is definite follow)

II. Some parks are restaurants → Does not follow → (As no restaurant is a shop and all parks are shops so, some parks are restaurants is not definite followed)

III. Some shops are parks → Follow → (As all parks are shops so, some shops are parks is definite follow)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusion I and III follow".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

68 + 85 - 15 ÷ 5 × 3 = 32
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Option 1) 85 and 15

Interchanged the numbers in equation we get:

⇒ 68 + 15 - __**85 ÷ 5**__ × 3 = 32

⇒ 68 + 15 - __**17 × 3**__ = 32

⇒ 68 + 15 - 51 = 32

⇒ __**83 - 51 **__= 32

⇒ 32 = 32

⇒ **LHS = RHS**
